name: SATHI MONDAL
review: I really loved EEVOLUTION 2.0. It is very helpful, clean, and easy to use for all students in our batch. The Upload Section is my favorite feature because it allows everyone to share notes and resources, which makes learning collaborative and supportive. The subject-wise organization makes it very easy to find study materials. The notices, documents, and batch information in one place will save a lot of time for students. This website is a great initiative and will be very useful for our studies. Great job—keep improving it, I’m excited for the next version!✨️. -sathi🌻

name: SOHAN KUNDU
review: EEvolution 2.0 feels like it has a real pulse makes all those hours of coding and organizing files totally worth it. Electrical Engineering is a gauntlet, so the goal was to kill the frantic 'Bhai Notes Ache?' WhatsApp hunt and replace it with a clean, no-nonsense hub that actually respects your time and sanity. By prioritizing radical simplicity and that collaborative upload feature, the platform is a digital lifeline built for the batch. It’s less about just hosting PDFs and more about ensuring that when the pressure of the semester hits, we’re all moving forward together instead of drowning in the clutter alone.
